translation.text: Great destruction will come upon all the earth, and floodwater will come, and [there will be] great destruction in one year.[a]

translation.text: This child who has been born to you will remain on the earth, and three children will be saved with him. When all the people on the earth die, he and his children will be saved.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected unit repeats that he and his children will be saved; the repetition is not discarded. Three children are explicit, but their names are not printed here and are not supplied from the visible Latin parallel or a familiar narrative. You represents the selected plural addressee without inventing an additional person. The English does not reinterpret all people as a new named ethnic or theological group.
